Bill.BriefDescription: Modifying provisions governing public works projects of code cities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to public works projects of code cities; andamending RCW 35A.40.210.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 35A.40.210 and 2009 c 229 s 5 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Procedures for any public work or improvement for code citiesshall be governed by RCW 35.23.352. ((Purchases for code cities with twenty thousand population or moreshall be governed by RCW 35.22.620.)) (2) Purchases for code citieswith ((under)) a population of fewer than twenty thousand((population)) shall be governed by RCW 35.23.352. (3)(a) Subject to the limitations established in (b) of thissubsection (3), code cities with populations of twenty thousand or moremay have public works performed by city employees in any annual orbiennial budget period at an amount equal to or less than nine percentof the public works construction budget, including any amounts in asupplemental public works construction budget for the same budgetperiod. p. 1 HB 2618 (b) Code cities may not have city employees perform public worksprojects in excess of: (i) Two hundred thousand dollars if more thanone trade or craft is involved in the project; or (ii) sixty thousanddollars if only a single craft or trade is involved in the project orif the project is street signalization or street lighting.
